## Pull request overview Adopts the updated normative-rule schema and terminology to align with the Parameters SIG, including renaming rules/tags and switching implementation-defined “parameters” to the new `impl-def-behavior` model. **Changes:** - Renames normative rule identifiers (uppercasing + underscore normalization) and updates corresponding AsciiDoc anchors/tags. - Replaces `kind: parameter` with `impl-def-behavior: true` (and `impl-def-category` for WARL/WLRL cases) across multiple rule definition YAMLs. - Updates the Makefile to run the tag-check script via `bash` and adds an `update-ref` helper target. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 30 out of 32 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.
